plan: A demonic general who pulls his enemies in and drains their life to become almost unkillable in fights.
aSurveiller: His E (Nevermove). The wave comes back to him and roots: step out of its return, then he pulls you to him.
contrer: Dodge his E both on the way out and back: it roots.
Back off during his R: he heals as long as he's near you.
Buy a Grievous Wounds item: he drains a lot of health.
faiblesses: His E is easy to see coming.

sorts.P: His ravens collect souls that heal him.
sorts.Q: Burst of projectiles in a cone.
sorts.W: Remote eye that slows and reveals.
sorts.E: Wave that comes back and roots.
sorts.R: Transforms and drains health around him.
